description: Chinese company Unitree Robotics closed its opening day on Shanghai's STAR Market at 845 yuan per share, after peaking at 1,100 yuan in earlier sessions. The robot maker raised nearly 6.1 billion yuan, or about 905 million US dollars, in its initial public offering.
classificationReason: The episode is entirely about Unitree Robotics’ public-market debut and fundraising.
qualityReason: Focused news report with concrete IPO and market-performance details, though not a technical discussion.
